analysis_role: new post-hoc descriptive sensitivity, specified for the ICDE revision
historical_primary_endpoint: unchanged: prefix 10, assess trials 11..n; two-point magnitude rule
units: all 30 locked raw-BN units; five source conditions x three seeds per backbone
eligibility: one common participant intersection across all 30 units, identical ordered trial keys and labels, n>50 and both classes in the common suffix; record exclusions
fit: linear-interpolated sample quantile at 1-0.5 using the first k unlabeled raw-logit scores only
reference: zero-logit decision on the very same suffix, ties positive for both rules
aggregation: equally average three seeds within each of five source conditions, equally average conditions within participant, then equally average participants by backbone
interval: descriptive 95% participant percentile bootstrap; 10000 shared index vectors across all k and both backbones; numpy default_rng(20261110)
selection: report every k for both backbones in specified order; no gate, multiplicity inference, optimal budget or model selection
